attributes.title: Level 6

subgroups.name: solve 1

steps.hints: ❓ What needs to be added inside the parentheses of setLayerImage to set the clouds image to a background layer?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ How is the layer parameter for a background image set?


Solution: 

.Layer1 should be added to the layer parameter of the setLayerImage code on Line 492.
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, there’s an error in the code! 


Fix the bugs in the code so that the clouds image is set correctly to a layer.

subgroups.title: Debugging the Background Scroll Extension
subgroups.introduction: Oh no - these programs aren’t working! Problems in code are called bugs. Find and fix the bugs in the code in each section!

validationItems.text: .Layer1 added to the layer parameter of the setLayerImage code on Line 492.
validationItems.failureText: Try adding a dot operator to the layer parameter to set the background layer that the clouds image is stored at.

subgroups.name: solve 2

steps.hints: ❓ Which layer should the city background image be set to so that it appears in front of the sky and cloud images, but behind the birds image?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ Which layer should the city background image be set to?


Solution: 

Layer3 changed to Layer2 in setLayerImage code on Line 493.
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, the city image does not appear on screen! 


Fix the bugs in the code so that the city image appears in front of the sky and cloud images, but behind the birds image.

validationItems.text: Layer3 changed to Layer2 in setLayerImage code on Line 493.
validationItems.failureText: Try updating the background layer that the city image is set to.

subgroups.name: solve 3

steps.hints: ❓ Which layer should be used for the sky background image so that it appears furthest from the camera?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ Which layer should the sky background image be set to?


Solution: 

Layer4 changed to Layer0 in setLayerImage code on Line 492.
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, only the sky image appears on screen!


Fix the bugs in the code so that the sky image appears furthest from the camera.

subgroups.name: solve 4

steps.hints: ❓What should the vx parameter of scrollBackgroundWithSpeed be set to so that layer 3 scrolls right?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ What number values cause a background layer to scroll right on screen?


Solution: 

- should be deleted from the vx parameter of scrollBackgroundWithSpeed code on Line 499.
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, layers 1, 2, and 3 of the background all move in the same direction. 


Fix the bugs in the code so that layer 3 scrolls right.

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 6 of Purple Belt! Before you create your final Purple Belt project, there are a few neat tricks to learn that could take your game to the next level! Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 6:

badges.title: Extension Explorer
badges.description: Use animation and music code, plus the scroller and story extensions, to enhance a project.

badges.title: Stop Motion
badges.description: Use an array of images to create an animation for a sprite.

badges.title: Path of Least Resistance
badges.description: Use an animation preset path to animate a sprite’s movement.

badges.title: Earworm
badges.description: Create a custom melody using a string of note names.

badges.title: Seven Layer Dip
badges.description: Use the Scroller extension to change the background image layers.

badges.title: Parallax Party
badges.description: Use the Scroller extension to move a background layer to create a parallax effect.

badges.title: The Choice is Yours
badges.description: Use the Story extension to present the player with choices.

badges.title: Stage Directions
badges.description: Use the Story extension to move a sprite to a specific position.

badges.title: What’s my Line?
badges.description: Use the Story extension to have a sprite say text with custom colors.
